If this official is killed or abducted by the aliens, it would undoubtedly spread panic and reduce the effectiveness of XCOM. We need a squad of your soldiers to escort the target safely to the extraction point.

General Van Doorn was very grateful for his rescue from the alien abduction attempt. He was so intrigued by our operations that he and his aide decided to resign from the UN Peacekeeping command to start their training as XCOM operatives.
The Council is concerned by this setback, but we are confident you will adapt your tactics accordingly.
